newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen up again as KGHM offer ends.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen up again as KGHM offer ends.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Thursday's 0.9-percent gain on Friday as the market, currently at 15,208.2 points, was reacting to its fall from about 16,500 points in mid-June, analysts said.
They said that the end of the public offering of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz SA on Friday would also free up cash for listed stocks.
Analysts also said Bank Handlowy could rise for the fourth session running after having started trade on Monday 8.3 percent above issue.
